[alt] A banner ad from Chicago StreetsBlog for the bicycle advocacy organization Ride Illinois. The ad is captioned, "Ride Illinois is making Illinois better through biking! Visit ride illinois dot org to get involved". The image itself is an illustration in watercolor style of several schoolchildren pedaling down the street on bicycles, shown from behind. The art shows multiple common "tells" for imagery generated by a neural network: the spokes of the bicycle wheels are simultaneously too visible for a vehicle at speed and also unnaturally bendy to the point of even seeming to bend into the path of the tire; linework on the pleated jacket of the leftmost child is wispy and fades without reason; a car and the scenery behind it in the far background are eldritch blobs riddled with artifacting where a real watercolor would be more indistinct.
